objects.X: An arbitrary fixed smooth projective complex variety; no counterexample candidate selected.
objects.Z: Z^p(X)_Q, the Q-vector space of finite formal codimension-p algebraic cycles, allowing negative coefficients.
objects.R_rat: The subspace generated by rational equivalences.
objects.P: A possible set of source-bound retained packet presentations, not yet constructed for algebraic cycles.
objects.R_packet: The free Q-vector space on P, if such a presentation library is supplied.
objects.V: An independently defined rational target for a possible class obstruction.

maps.claim: Every assigned packet must supply an actual algebraic cycle; no coverage of all cycles asserted.

descent_lemma.statement: For Q-linear s:R->H and F:R->V, there is a unique linear Fbar:im(s)->V with F=Fbar o s iff ker(s) is contained in ker(F).

annihilation_consequence: If a assigns genuine algebraic cycles and O annihilates every algebraic cycle class, then F=O o s must be zero on every such packet. Distinguishing two presentations of the same class cannot itself be a Hodge obstruction.
noncircularity: An arbitrary extension from im(s) to H cannot supply an independently computed detector of missing algebraic classes. A claimed nonalgebraic complement already requires proof that im(cl) is proper.
